nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML shell for the Create React App build that provides the #root div the React application mounts into, and wires up the favicon, viewport meta tags, and PWA manifest link.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the CRA %PUBLIC_URL% placeholder, which is replaced with the public folder URL at build time; this is the mount target where src/index.tsx renders the React root.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: Progressive Web App manifest defining the PMS (Phuc Sinh Home) app's short name, icons, start URL, and standalone display mode used when the app is installed on a mobile or desktop device.

nodes.name: robots.txt
nodes.summary: Robots exclusion file that allows all web crawlers unrestricted access to the site, with no disallowed paths configured.
